rules.name: Black Knight's Tonic
rules.description:
One use only. Duration: One Phase. 
The first time the model suffers an unsaved wound from an attack with Multiple Wounds (X), it gains Immune (Multiple Wounds).

rules.name: Oriflamme
rules.description: The bearer’s unit gains Afflict (-1 Dis), Horror.

rules.name: Banner of Roland
rules.description:
The bearer’s unit gains Aegis (5+, against Ranged Attacks). 
 In addition, enemy units with Stand and Shoot cannot use this rule towards the bearer’s unit.

rules.name: Relic Shroud
rules.description: The bearer can cast Breath of the Lady (Hereditary Spell) as a Bound Spell (5+).

rules.name: Lady's Favour
rules.description:
One use only. May be activated when the bearer’s unit is chosen as the target of an Orison. 
 The bearer’s unit gains the effects of all Orisons (i.e Discipline set to 9, +2 Off, Aegis (5+), Magical Attacks, and ignore Parry), with Duration: One Turn.

rules.name: Castellan's Crest
rules.description:
One use only. May be activated immediately after failing a Charge Range roll with the bearer or the bearer’s unit in the Charge Phase: the bearer or its unit must reroll its failed Charge Range roll. 
 Other Characters Charging out of the bearer’s unit are not affected.

rules.name: Tristan's Resolve
rules.description:
+1 Att, +1 AP. 
 After a successful to-hit roll, the bearer may discard one of the hits made with this weapon and choose an Enchanted Weapon carried by the model the attack was allocated against: at the end of the Agility Step all Weapon Enchantments on it are ignored and the weapon ceases to be an Enchanted Weapon. Duration: Permanent.

rules.name: Mortal Reminder
rules.description: +1 Str, +1 AP, and Terror.

rules.name: Divine Judgement
rules.description: If the wielder successfully completes a Charge, apply the following: +2 Str, +2 AP, with Duration: End of Combat.

rules.name: Uther's Mettle
rules.description:
+X Att, where X is equal to the number of ranks in a single enemy unit in contact with the wielder, up to a maximum of 4 (if in contact with multiple units, use the one with the most ranks). 
 These extra attacks can only be allocated against Rank-and-File models (if the attacks cannot be allocated against Rank-and-File models, they are lost).

rules.name: Prayer Etched
rules.description: +1 Arm, and Aegis (+1, max. 4+).

rules.name: Percival's Panoply
rules.description: +2 Arm.

rules.name: Fortress of Faith
rules.description: The wearer gains Holy Vows, and all Armour Save rolls of ‘1’ made by the wearer must be rerolled.

rules.name: Sacred Chalice
rules.description:
The bearer gains Magic Resistance (1). 
In addition, each time the bearer’s unit is the target of an enemy spell, the bearer gains Channel (1) until the end of the following Magic Phase.

rules.name: Quin
rules.description:
Counts as two Heroic Traits
The model is a Wizard Adept that chooses Witchcraft as its Path of Magic. 
 If without Mount, the model also gains Scout.

rules.name: Cleric
rules.description: The model gains Clergy, Ordo Minister, and Holy Vows, and loses Commonfolk.

rules.name: Bannerman
rules.description: The model becomes the Battle Standard Bearer.

rules.name: Minstrel
rules.description: The model gains Musician and is a Wizard Apprentice that chooses Divination as its Path of Magic.

rules.name: Castellan
rules.description: The bearer gains Captain, Commanding Presence (6", Commonfolk).

rules.name: Honour
rules.description: The model part gains Devastating Charge(+2 Att), and its unit’s Charge Range rolls gain Maximised.

rules.name: Justice
rules.description:
At the end of Agility Step 0, the model part performs X additional Standard Melee Attacks, where X is equal to the number of HP losses suffered in the Round of Combat by Rank-and-File models in the bearer’s unit.
 X can never be greater than 3.\ If the model is unable to perform the additional attacks granted by Justice, those attacks are lost.

rules.name: Valour
rules.description: The bearer gains Fearless, Multiple Wounds (2, towards Res 5 or more).

rules.name: Excellence
rules.description: The bearer gains Zeal, and any Melee Attacks it allocates towards a Character gain +2 AP.

rules.name: Faith
rules.description:
The bearer gains Fearless and Holy Vows. 
 Moreover, if its unit is the target of an Orison while Engaged in Combat, add one Blessing Token to your pool.

rules.name: Forbearance
rules.description: When Using a Shield, the model gains Distracting (1).

rules.name: Generosity
rules.description:
The model gains Attached,Exclusive (Rank-and-File). 
In addition, Rank-and-File models with Nobility in the unit that the bearer is Deployed in gain a Bastard Sword and Weapon Master, with Duration: Permanent.

sharedRules.name: Traits of a Hero
sharedRules.description: The Folk Hero must choose one or two different Heroic Traits.

sharedRules.name: Forest Guide
sharedRules.description: The model’s unit gains Magical Attacks, Strider (Forest).

sharedRules.name: Solemn Oath
sharedRules.description: The model benefits from Courageous while affected by a friendly model's Commanding Presence.

sharedRules.name: Braziers
sharedRules.description: In each Shooting Phase, before selecting its target, a unit containing Braziers may choose to gain Flaming Attacks (Shooting), with Duration: One Phase.

sharedRules.name: Knights Forlorn
sharedRules.description: The model gains Nobility and the Men-at-Arms model part gains Bastard Sword.

sharedRules.name: Ordo Wardens
sharedRules.description: The model gains Clergy and the Men-at-Arms model part gains Great Weapon.

sharedRules.name: Castle Guard
sharedRules.description: The model gains Commonfolk and the Men-at-Arms model part gains Spear.

sharedRules.name: Stalwart Defence
sharedRules.description: Enemy units in Contact with the model lose Devastating Charge.

sharedRules.name: Sacred Relic
sharedRules.description:
A unit containing Sacred Relic benefits from Fight in Extra Rank. 
In addition, when the unit is the target of an Orison while Engaged in Combat, add one Blessing Token to your pool. Ignore this effect if a Character with the Faith Knightly Principle is part of the model’s unit. 
The Sacred Reliquary model part gains all Weapons of the Rank-and-File models in the unit it is joined to, with Duration: Permanent.

sharedRules.name: The Quest
sharedRules.description:
During Pre-game Selections, an army containing The Quest selects a unit entry from the opponent’s Army Book, which cannot be a Character mount (but can be a Character Entry). 
 All instances of the selected Unit Entry in the opponent’s Army List are marked with a Quest Marker. 
 Model parts with The Quest benefit from Lethal Strike (against units containing a Quest Marker), Zeal (against units containing a Quest Marker).

sharedRules.name: Hooded Men
sharedRules.description: The model gains Hard Target (1), Skirmisher.

sharedRules.name: Courtier of the Dawn
sharedRules.description:
The model gains Fly, Wizard Conclave (1)
 The unit selects its spells from the following: Predator’s Instinct (Shamanism)

sharedRules.name: Courtier of the Dusk
sharedRules.description:
The model gains Wizard Conclave (2).
 The unit selects its spells from the following: Fountain of Youth (Druidism), Stone Skin (Druidism), Mind Fog (Witchcraft), Shrouded Steps (Witchcraft),

sharedRules.name: Champion of the Green Knight
sharedRules.description:
The Fey Rider model part gains a Bastard Sword. Place a Forest* underneath the model until the model is removed as a casualty. 
This Forest always extends up to the edges of the model’s Unit Boundary (and no further), even if the unit moves or changes its formation. 
 * You may place a marker next to the unit instead.

sharedRules.name: Chosen of the Snow Childe
sharedRules.description: When performing its Standard Melee Attacks, the Fey Rider model part gains +1 Att for each enemy model in contact with it; moreover, its Standard Melee Attacks ignore Parry.

sharedRules.name: Warden of the Hooded Man
sharedRules.description:
The model gains Terror. 
 The Fey Rider model part gains a Lance, and its Standard Melee Attacks gain Multiple Wounds (2, against Height 4-5).

sharedRules.name: Orisons
sharedRules.description:
During Pre-game Selections, a Kingdom of Equitaine army creates a pool of Blessing Tokens: one for each unit in your Army List with Holy Vows. There can never be more than 6 tokens in the pool.Blessing Tokens can be used in each Magic Phase, at any time before Casting Spells (Magic Phase, 5): discard a Token, choose a friendly unit anywhere on the battlefield, and grant one of the following Model Rules. All those effects have Duration: One Turn. 
 • Orison of Discipline: Discipline set to 9. 
 • Orison of Shielding: Aegis (5+). 
 • Orison of Striking: +2 Off, Magical Attacks, and ignore Parry. Model parts with Mount are not affected. 
 No model can be affected by more than one of the above effects simultaneously unless specifically stated. 
Applying an Orison to a model cancels any Orisons previously applied to it, unless specifically stated that it can be affected by them simultaneously.

sharedRules.name: The Blessing
sharedRules.description:
Unit profiles in this Army Book contain an additional Characteristic: Aegis (Aeg). This gives the unit the model rule Aegis (X+), where X is the Aeg value. 
 Remember that lack of an Aeg value does not prevent a unit from being affected by Aegis modifiers.

sharedRules.name: Sainted
sharedRules.description:
The model part gains +1 Att, and the model gains Fearless.
The model is always considered to be under the effect of all Orisons at the same time (i.e. Discipline set to 9, +2 Off, Aegis (5+), Magical Attacks, ignore Parry).
This does not prevent the model’s unit from being the target of an Orison, although the model itself does not benefit from this additional Orison.

sharedRules.name: Knight Banneret
sharedRules.description:
A unit containing a Knight Banneret adds +1 to the Combat Score of its side. 
In addition, it can take a single Banner Enchantment from the list of Army Specific Magic Items.

sharedRules.name: Ordo Minister
sharedRules.description:
Anytime during a friendly Magic Phase, before Casting Spells (Magic Phase, 5), each unit containing Ordo Minister may gain one of the following effects: 
 • Raise 1 HP on a Rank-and-File Health Pool in the unit. 
 • Discard 1 Blessing Token and Recover 1 HP on any model in the unit.

sharedRules.name: Nobility
sharedRules.description:
The model gains Aegis (5+, against no Armour Save*). 
*This Aegis save can only be used against attacks where the model cannot take an Armour Save, or would automatically fail it.

sharedRules.name: Clergy
sharedRules.description: The model gains Aegis (5+, against Magical Attacks).

sharedRules.name: Commonfolk
sharedRules.description: The model gains Aegis (5+) while Engaged in the same Combined Combat as another friendly unit.

sharedRules.name: Lance Formation
sharedRules.description:
A unit entirely with Lance Formation only needs to have three files to form Proper Ranks. 
 However, the unit is never considered to have more than one Proper Rank for the purpose of Rank Bonus. Moreover, when in a unit that has exactly three files, each model part on a model with Lance Formation gains two instances of Fight in Extra Rank.

sharedRules.name: Bastard Sword
sharedRules.description: Counts as a Hand Weapon, with the following additional rules: +1 Str, and Devastating Charge (+1 AP).

sharedRules.name: Prepared Position
sharedRules.description:
When Deploying the unit, you may place a Wall fully within 1" of the unit’s Front Facing, and not in contact with any other Terrain Features. 
This Wall cannot be wider than 1", nor longer than 8". 
 It follows the normal rules for Walls, with the exception that it is Covering Terrain (Height 1) instead of Height 3.

sharedRules.description: Add two Blessing Tokens to your pool.
